items.title: Bitcoin ETF inflows snap after $3 billion streak as ETH, XRP and Solana keep buying
items.whyYouShouldCare: The halt in Bitcoin ETF inflows could shift investor focus towards alternative assets like Solana, potentially increasing its liquidity and market interest.

items.title: Solana validators approve proposal to accelerate SOL disinflation
items.whyYouShouldCare: The approval of the disinflation proposal by Solana validators indicates a commitment to reducing supply, which may enhance SOL's value proposition.

items.title: Morning Minute: Solana Jumps with Network Inflation Set to Drop
items.whyYouShouldCare: The anticipated drop in network inflation could position Solana favorably, attracting users and investors looking for a more stable asset.
